facts.fact: ST Digital's CTO says hosting and colocation are the base offer of its Nkok sovereign data centre, inaugurated by the president days earlier, and that the site is ramping up.
facts.system: ST Digital Nkok sovereign data centre

facts.fact: ST Digital's CTO calls the Nkok data centre Tier III by design (N+1, dual power path) while Uptime Institute certification is still in progress and targeted within months.
